text.en:
Hazardous Duty. Personnel of the Integrated National Police may be entitled to hazardous duty
pay when engaged in the following hazardous duties:
(a) Combat operations in critical and embattled areas of the country against insurgents, rebels and/or terrorists;
(b) Crime prevention or suppression operations against armed criminals;
(c) Firefighting operations which require the rescue of persons that are trapped inside burning buildings or
structures; and
(d) Exposure to radiation hazards and to danger in connection with the disarming/disposal of bombs, mines,
grenades and other lethal or explosive devices and chemicals.

Hazardous Duty Pay. Subject to the availability of funds, personnel of the Integrated National
Police performing hazardous duties as enumerated in the preceding section shall be entitled to receive
hazardous duty pay of a maximum of ONE HUNDRED TWENTY PESOS (P120.00) per month: Provided,
that payment of hazardous duty pay shall be made only upon presentation of ample proof that the claimant had
experienced or been exposed to hazardous duties at least once during the month.

Implementing Rules and Regulations. The Director General of the Integrated National Police
shall promulgate the necessary rules and regulations to implement this decree subject to the approval of the
Minister of National Defense.

Funding Source. The Director General of the Integrated National Police is authorized to use
savings in appropriations for personal services to fund the hazardous duty pay authorized by this Decree. The
amount the conditions for the approval of hazardous duty pay shall be adjusted from time to time so as to be
within the limit of funds available from this source.

Recession Clause. Any provision of law, rules and regulations inconsistent with the foregoing is
hereby modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Decree shall take effect upon approval.

Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
